teach_en: A pure 'oh' with tight, rounded lips, held steady: say 'go' but don't let it slide into 'oo'. It is written before the consonant. Rounder and closer than the 'aw' of ບໍ່.
notes: From vowels.csv V18 pron_tip (verified: long 'o' as in 'go', without the glide) and SOUND_HINTS V18 (pure 'oh', no slide; not ◌ໍ). The owner is Midwest US, where 'go' glides, hence the 'don't slide' cue. Wording by agent.

teach_en: The same m sound as ມ, written as one letter (ຫ joined to ມ). Words with ໝ often have a different melody, so learn it with each word.
notes: From letters.csv C31 pron_tip (verified: same sound as ມ; also written ຫມ). Class not named (decision 11); the melody cue follows lesson 14's ຮ card. Wording by agent.
